summary: XTL Biopharmaceuticals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval of its acquisition of 80-100% of Psyga Bio Ltd. The consideration consists of XTL ordinary shares and milestone warrants issued via private placement. Shareholders also approved a conditional $1.5M private placement from Alexander Rabinovitch and/or other investors, contingent on deal closing, plus an increase in authorized shares from ~2.9B to 5.8B NIS 0.1 ordinary shares to fund the transaction. The board recommended the deal; no advisors named. The acquisition gives XTL control of Psyga. Watch for regulatory clearance and customary closing conditions; risk-arb spread hinges on shareholder and regulatory timelines.
